concerns: Reliance on upstream pick['btc_regime'] freshness could lead to stale data affecting rejection logic.
Overlap with NS-D and elite_scorer.py adjustments may lead to redundant rejection or scoring penalties, though acceptable as per constraints.
missing_edge_cases: No explicit handling for cases where pick['btc_regime'] or related fields are missing or None (though upstream population is assumed).
No test for edge case where BTC_BEAR_LONG_REJECT env var is set to an unexpected value (e.g., non-string or empty string after trimming).
